chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was shown in his dream that Banī Umayyah would ascend his pulpit after him, leading the people astray from the path, backwards. So he awoke distressed and sorrowful. Then Jibrīl عليه السلام descended to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, why do I see you distressed and sorrowful?" He said, "O Jibrīl, I saw Banī Umayyah on this night of mine ascending my pulpit after me, leading the people astray from the path, backwards." He said, "By the One Who sent you with the truth as a Prophet, this is indeed something of which I had no knowledge." Then he ascended to the heaven and soon came down to him with verses from the Qur'an by which He consoled him:
"Have you then considered: if We let them enjoy themselves for years, then there came to them that which they had been promised, what would avail them that which they used to enjoy?"
And He revealed to him: "Indeed, We sent it down in the Night of al-Qadr. And what will make you know what the Night of al-Qadr is? The Night of al-Qadr is better than a thousand months."
He made Laylat al-Qadr for His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله better than a thousand months of the rule of Banī Umayyah."

key_terms.أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ: a thousand months, contrasted here with Laylat al-Qadr and linked to Umayyad rule
key_terms.بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ: Banī Umayyah, the Umayyad clan whose future rule is described here
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrīl, the angel who descends with revelation and consolation
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ: the Night of al-Qadr, described as better than a thousand months
key_terms.مِنْبَرَهُ: his pulpit, symbolizing the Prophet’s public authority and position
key_terms.ٱلصِّرَاطِ: the path, meaning the right way from which people are led astray
key_terms.ٱلْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, the revealed scripture brought as consolation

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith connect Laylat al-Qadr with the rule of Banī Umayyah?
ai.summary: This report describes a dream shown to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله about Banī Umayyah ascending his pulpit and misleading people after him, which caused him grief. Jibrīl عليه السلام then brought Qur'anic verses to console him, including the passage that worldly enjoyment does not benefit wrongdoers in the end and that Laylat al-Qadr is better than a thousand months. The narration presents these verses as divine consolation in relation to the future rule of Banī Umayyah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2022 - It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, was shown in his dream that the sons of Umayyah would ascend his pulpit after him, leading people astray and turning them away from the straight path. When he awoke, he was sorrowful and grieved.
Archangel Jibril (as) descended to him and asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), why do I see you sorrowful and grieved?"
The Prophet replied: "O Jibril, I saw in my dream the sons of Umayyah ascending my pulpit after me, leading people astray and turning them away from the straight path."
Archangel Jibril (as) said: "By the One who sent you with the truth as a Prophet, I was not aware of this matter." He then ascended to the heavens and shortly returned with verses of the Quran to console the Prophet (sw):

"Have you considered if We let them enjoy themselves for years, then there comes to them that which they were promised, it will not avail them that which they used to enjoy." (Surah Ash-Shu’ara 26:205–207)

And He revealed to Him (sw):
"Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Qadr. And what will make you know what the Night of Qadr is? The Night of Qadr is better than a thousand months." (Surah Al-Qadr 97:1–3)
Allah (swt) made the Night of Qadr for His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, better than a thousand months of the rule of the sons of Umayyah.
